title: Strong Entity Id Comments and Owned Unions
description: Annotate strong entity ids with #uuidv7; add Owned unions immediately below each Owner union (or # union XOwned = Nothing); sync ownedEntities comments with XOwned.
summary: Every `# StrongEntity` block now uses `id: ID! # uuidv7` (Operation interface already matched). Each `union …Owner = …` is immediately followed by `union …Owned = …` or `# union …Owned = Nothing` when no concrete owned members (Position/Location/attribute gaps/Operation/File/ChangedDescription). Added concrete Owned unions where meaningful (Place/Author/Kit/VCS/Type/Piece ops/etc.). Updated concrete `ownedEntities` fields with `# XOwned` comments; Operation uses `# OperationOwned` instead of `# Input`. Full cargo test + graphql-core parse pass.
